confidence_reason: Registered Knock It Off source and a current public ordinary-key clear establish cana locks the nearest hero at windup; a boomerang can displace the light sac from the duct. Novice discovery, human error rate, and comfort remain unmeasured; the separate source-blind probe stopped without delivery or a clear.

confirmed: The boomerang/sac/ferry, weight-two delivery, powered bridge, and separate exits were genuine.
missed_mechanics: Either hero can push the light sac; STEADY is optional in the demonstrated route, and passive opening throw can extract the sac.
incorrect_inferences: The first pass made Isp stabilization sound necessary and did not know that a hero plus sac satisfies DELIVERY 2. The later public probe did not prove a jump defect: DIZZY only slows horizontal speed in source, platform undersides are solid, and live time elapsed between sequential jump and move commands.
changed_judgments: cooperation: 3 to 2; The demonstrated route assigns useful cargo work to Pac and Isp and one hero holds power while the other rides, but cargo pushing is exchangeable.
execution: 2 to 3; Ferry-side cargo contact, floor delivery, and powered bridge boarding add several placements.
recovery_cost: unknown to 1; The sac remains recoverable on the gutter; a wrong throw recurs or public Restart resets the short setup.
solution_clarity: 2 to 3; Title and villain line cue a wrong-recipient throw, but the sac-plus-hero weight and ferry push are not fully taught by idle labels.

Prior-concept correction: level_03, rather than the door-only level_02 HOLD, introduced stopping a moving ferry. It remains an earlier exposure, so this introducer correction does not change novelty or establish mastery.
unresolved: The public probe did not clear or deliver; it cannot establish human difficulty. A cargo-free cooperative empty-bridge staging completion is unproven, not required or rejected here.

Probe actions 15-16 and 20-21 were separated by live tooling/thinking gaps, so they were not continuous airborne combinations; source can explain possibilities but does not reproduce each failed jump causally.

single_operator_note: One operator must sequence or chord both key sets; that extra demand is excluded from the two-human baseline ratings.
